tasks.title: Implement SkillService with loading and execution
tasks.description: Create src/services/skill-service.ts with SkillService class. Constructor takes SkillRepo, SkillRunRepo, IssueService, EventBus, opencodeBinPath. scanAndRegister(projectPath) scans .mohist/skills/ for SKILL.md, parses frontmatter (hand-written parser: split on ---, regex extract key:value), upserts to DB. run(skillName, projectId) validates skill exists, creates skill_runs record, emits skill_started, fires async ACP session via runAcpSession(), on completion updates run record, creates Issue via IssueService (title from first line stripping # prefix, body=full text, labels=['skill-generated']), emits skill_completed or skill_failed. getRuns(skillId) returns history. Constructor auto-calls scanAndRegister for current project.
acceptanceCriteria: scanAndRegister discovers SKILL.md in .mohist/skills/ subdirectories
Frontmatter parsing handles: full frontmatter, no prompt field (uses body), no frontmatter (defaults), missing description (uses dir name)
scanAndRegister upserts skills to DB (insert new, update existing by name)
run() throws 'Skill not found: X' when skill missing
run() creates skill_runs record with status=running and returns immediately
run() fires async ACP session with correct cwd, task, eventBus, timeout
On ACP success: run record updated to completed, Issue created with labels=['skill-generated']
On ACP failure: run record updated to failed with error
Issue title extracted from first line of ACP text (stripped # prefix), fallback title for empty output
IssueService.create() failure does not prevent run record from being marked completed
EventBus emits skill_started, skill_completed, skill_failed with correct payloads
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Key design decisions: D1 (hand-written frontmatter parser), D3 (direct runAcpSession not AgentRunnerService), D4 (fire-and-forget async), D5 (title from first line).

tasks.title: Add REST API routes for skills
tasks.description: Create src/api/skills.ts with createSkillRoutes(skillService, projectService) returning Hono router. Three endpoints: GET / (list skills for current project, 400 if no project), POST /:name/run (trigger execution, 202 Accepted with runId/status/skillName, 404 if skill not found, 400 if no project), GET /:name/runs (execution history with output truncated to 500 chars, 404 if skill not found). Register in server/index.ts via server.addRouter('/api/skills', ...).
acceptanceCriteria: createSkillRoutes accepts skillService and projectService, returns Hono instance
GET /api/skills returns 200 with skills array (id, name, description, createdAt)
GET /api/skills returns 400 when no project context
POST /api/skills/:name/run returns 202 with { runId, status: 'running', skillName }
POST /api/skills/:name/run returns 404 when skill not found
POST /api/skills/:name/run returns 400 when no project context
GET /api/skills/:name/runs returns 200 with run records (output truncated to 500 chars)
GET /api/skills/:name/runs returns 404 when skill not found
Route registered in server/index.ts with server.addRouter('/api/skills', ...)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow existing route patterns (createAgentRoutes, createExploreRoutes). Project context via projectService.getCurrentId().
